name: Hybrid Volume Rendering with Space Leaping
definition: A hybrid approach that uses hardware-supported 2D texture mapping and OpenGL per-fragment operations to classify materials and determine visible regions, followed by software-based volume ray-casting on the original data set to render illuminated structures, avoiding memory and image quality drawbacks of pure texture mapping.
summary: Hybrid Volume Rendering with Space Leaping combines hardware-accelerated texture culling with software raycasting to skip empty space and render high-quality illumination directly from original data.
